alias.description: Account this key really belongs to; a profile with `alias` carries no other field.

avatar.description: The account's picture, as an `ipfs://` link to an image.

description.description: A short description of the account.

account.description: Account the profile is for, set only when a delegated key signs on its behalf.

description: A snapshot blob giving an account its display name, avatar and description, or an alias redirecting one key to another.
